infinitive expressing purpose or directed readiness
locative or adverbial sense indicating central position

items.question: What state of poised readiness is conveyed by feet worn yet eager to advance?
premises: The two feet are described as rubbed and worn.
They are positioned standing in the middle.
They are risen and ready to rush forward.
items.inference: Despite wear from effort, a poised readiness to advance remains active in the middle position.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the dual subjects is not explicit within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Like two feet rubbed worn, standing in the middle, risen and ready to rush forward.
